text: {"ops":[{"op":"reweight","id":"5e69a7af","weight":1.80},{"op":"add","content":"When a GPU model keyword (e.g., H100, A100) is followed by an equals sign and a numeric value, treat the value as a resource‑allocation entry and store it even if no unit is present; this captures patterns like \"H100 = 2400\".","weight":1.00}]}
